evals.prompt:
can you clean up this SQL? it's from our reporting job and feels way too repetitive:
SELECT u.id, CASE WHEN u.nickname IS NULL THEN u.name ELSE u.nickname END AS display_name, (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments p WHERE p.user_id = u.id AND p.status = 'paid') AS paid FROM users u WHERE (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments p WHERE p.user_id = u.id AND p.status = 'paid') > 100;
